effect_description_eng:
When this card would be played, if there are 3 or more Digimon, reduce the play cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 2 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of your Digimon may get +5000 DP for the turn and attack your opponent's Digimon.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon may unsuspend.
[Your Turn] All of your [Iliad] trait Digimon gain ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.) and ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
